patterns.decision_reminder: User confirmation accepts a direction; it does not prove that the Host materialized or verified the result.
evidence_queries: Compare the accepted action with the materialization receipt.
Inspect the final rendered scope, not only the proposal.
Require every declared postcondition to have a receipt.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not map CONFIRMED directly to VERIFIED or CONSUMED.

patterns.decision_reminder: A visual subcell proposal is incomplete until output cells are clipped to the visual scope and exclude adjacent headings.
evidence_queries: Compare every output cell bbox with the visual scope bbox.
Search output cell text for following heading evidence.
Inspect a rendered crop of the proposed logical region.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not reuse one mixed physical cell as the materialized visual table.

patterns.decision_reminder: Visible direct content must have one nearest structural owner; parents do not repeat evidence already owned by children.
evidence_queries: Compare parent direct refs with descendant-owned refs and regions.
Check bbox overlap between parent text and child tables.
Inspect the final parent and child views together.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not preserve duplicate text merely because it came from a different extraction channel.

patterns.decision_reminder: Repeated native title lines are extraction duplicates unless distinct source geometry proves separate visible occurrences.
evidence_queries: Normalize and count identical title-only lines.
Compare duplicate title bboxes and rotation transforms.
Check whether the table or document node already owns the title.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not expose repeated title text as direct body content.

patterns.decision_reminder: One logical table needs one canonical column contract; physical continuation fragments cannot define independent visible schemas.
evidence_queries: Derive canonical columns from the owning header contract.
Map every fragment cell to canonical column roles.
Compare continuation headers, axes, and applicability before publishing.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer visible columns independently for each physical fragment.

patterns.decision_reminder: Every visual placement must be shown in a cell, shown as a floating table placement, or remain explicitly unresolved.
evidence_queries: Compare every expected placement with rendered cell and floating placements.
Inspect row and column ranges crossed by each image bbox.
Report placements that cannot be assigned to one cell.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not discard an image because no single cell exceeds an overlap threshold.

patterns.decision_reminder: Source membership does not require a navigation node for every minor list line; preserve compact direct content when items are not independently navigable.
evidence_queries: Check whether each child has an independent heading or stable scoped role.
Compare navigation value with the parent direct-content view.
Preview the before-and-after tree granularity.
patterns.forbidden_shortcut: Do not equate every numbered or bulleted source line with a tree node.
